detail.longDescription: I have an Excel spreadsheet that contains a list of sensor names and their status at different points in time. The goal is to ingest the spreadsheet into a DataFrame , remove duplicates, and then export the DataFrame to a database. Some sensor names are duplicated in the list due to bookkeeping errors. For the names that are duplicated, I want to drop the duplicated rows, keeping 1 row with the worst-recorded status at each time period. Name Sample1 Sample2 Sample3 A Green Yellow Yellow B Green Yellow Red A Yellow Yellow Red C Green Green Green B Green Green Yellow I figured out how to reduce index "A" to a single series: In: df = df.set_index("Name") dweights = {"RED": 3, "YELLOW": 2, "GREEN": 1, None: 0} # for name in df.index.unique().tolist(): name = "A" dfdup = df.loc[name] if len(dfdup.index) > 1: dfweights = dfdup.copy() for i in range(len(dfdup.index)): for j in range(len(dfdup.columns)): dfweights.iloc[i,j] = dweights[dfdup.iloc[i,j]] mask = dfweights == dfweights.max() dfresult = dfdup.where(mask, "").max() In: dfresults Out: Sample1 Yellow Sample2 Yellow Sample3 Red How do I replace the 2 rows of df["A"] with the series dfresults without dropping duplicate rows (dropping duplicates from all of df would also affect "B" which hasn't been processed yet). EDIT: I have updated my code per Arash's answer: In: df = df.set_index("Name") dweights = {"RED": 3, "YELLOW": 2, "GREEN": 1, None: 0} df = df.groupby(level=0).agg( lambda s: s.loc[s.map(dweights).idxmax()]) In: df Out: Name Sample1 Sample2 Sample3 A ["Green", "Yellow"] ["Yellow", "Yellow"] ["Yellow", "Red"] B ["Green", "Green"] ["Green", "Yellow"] ["Yellow", "Red"] C "Green" "Green" "Green" I'm not sure why I'm getting lists of all options instead of the "worst case" (i.e. highest weighted value) option.
